summary: Nondeterminism error occurs during workflow replay when the SDK sends Update Accepted and StartTimer commands twice for the same update instance, causing an invalid state transition error.
userImpact: Users experience nondeterminism errors during workflow replay that can cause invalid state transitions and prevent reliable workflow execution.
rootCause: The SDK incorrectly duplicates UpdateResponse and StartTimer commands for the same update instance during workflow replay instead of generating them once.
keyQuote: On the failed replay attempt, lang is sending the Update Accepted and Start Timer commands twice for the same update instance.
